title: LuaJIT 3.0 proposed syntax extensions
summary: This is a GitHub issue proposing new syntax extensions for LuaJIT 3.0, the high-performance Just-In-Time compiler for the Lua programming language. The proposal outlines potential language enhancements that would expand Lua's syntax capabilities while maintaining compatibility with existing code.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for modern syntax features in Lua to improve developer ergonomics and code expressiveness while preserving LuaJIT's legendary performance.
why_valuable: LuaJIT is already the fastest Lua implementation; syntax extensions would make the language more expressive without sacrificing its performance advantages, attracting more developers and enabling cleaner code.
